caption: Client wanted an interactive scroll based website experience for their real estate business. We wanted the user to virtually walk through the main property. What do you think? Did we cook? Comment 'build' to get in touch (1198 likes / 107 comments, 23 Jun)

typography.style: bold sans overlay for the POV hook ('POV ... wants a premium website'); minimal, confident

productPresentation: the real-estate site framed as an immersive experience — designer working in an actual high-end architectural interior (circular light ring, floor-to-ceiling glass, greenery), selling the idea of 'walking through the property' via scroll

hook.text: POV: client wants a premium website (for their real-estate business)

showcasedSite.layout: long-scroll cinematic real-estate site that alternates dark full-bleed hero sections with light editorial sections; rounded-corner imagery, generous whitespace, sticky nav with centered logo
sections: dark cinematic hero: serif headline 'Live Where the Sun Meets the Sea' over a warm amber interior photo, pill CTAs 'View Properties' + 'Book a Tour'
light editorial statement: 'For those who travel like it's an art form'
'Our Villas' intro with a modernist villa hero image
property cards: 2-column (Villa Blanca, Casa Dorada) each photo + name + one-line description
'Get In Touch' contact form (name / email) on a dark closing section
showcasedSite.typography: elegant serif display headlines + minimal sans body; refined luxury
components: sticky top nav with centered logo
interactions: smooth scroll walkthrough (scrollytelling): alternating dark/light full-bleed sections reveal as you scroll
the 'virtually walk through the property' concept via cinematic full-bleed sections
reuseForFactory: alternating dark-cinematic <-> light-editorial section rhythm for premium real-estate
serif headline + pill CTA hero over a warm property photo
inline 'Get In Touch' form in a dark closing section
scroll-linked reveals — ship a reduced-motion + LCP/CLS-safe fallback

webIdeas.heroDirection: Real-estate hero as a scroll-linked walkthrough: pin a hero property visual and reveal the space section by section as the user scrolls (scrollytelling / parallax), airy luxe-neutral palette.
motionForWeb: MANDATORY reduced-motion fallback: static gallery — heavy scroll-motion + big media, so budget LCP/CLS carefully
assetsToRequestOrReuse: study only - trend reel; for a REAL client this pattern needs real property photos/video/renders and a walkthrough
copyAngles: experiential framing: 'virtually walk through the property'
POV: 'client wants a premium website' is a strong content angle for ONIA's own reels

guardrails: scroll-heavy hero must ship a reduced-motion + performance-safe fallback
site captured clearly at 5s/9s/13s of the reel (logged into IG); site palette hexes are estimates from frames
